title: Negative て-form: い-Adjective くなくて
shortExplanation: The negative て-form of an い-adjective, for joining and giving reasons.
longExplanation: The negative くない conjugates like an い-adjective, so its て-form is くなくて (安くなくて、買わなかった, 'it wasn't cheap, so I didn't buy it').
formation: Drop the final い and add くなくて: 高い -> 高くなくて. Irregular: いい -> よくなくて.
